title: Norwegian Beef Stew with Thai Twist
description: A hearty and flavorful stew combining Norwegian beef with Thai spices and jubilant vegetables. This dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add onion and bell peppers to pot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add fish sauce, brown sugar, and beef broth. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Stir in coconut milk and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
